observation: Original field23 control tracing records 4669 complete primary-a7 calls, 78 encounter early returns and three terrain jump predicates. Every captured actor/control byte and call relationship matches the authored reconstruction. The route accepts three jump requests and rejects a second press while airborne. All 65 image/RAM/audio/external-state artifacts and the entire memory-sampling stream match a separately built uninstrumented core.
interpretation: The qualified a7 direction and jump-request behavior is reconstructed independently of later movement integration. The looping 0c wrapper and unobserved counter/alternate-mode branches have source/synthetic coverage. Active encounter selection raises an explicit unknown rather than disappearing into a no-op. Eligibility in this handler alone does not establish full player, dialogue or transition readiness.
author: Codex /root, original source and execution analysis on 2026-09-08

validation.expected: Exact source, request-state, call-correlation and complete control-output equality. Explicitly reject corruptions and retain unobserved branches and remaining physics work.
validation.actual: 9500 trace records compare exactly: 4669 a7 calls, 78 encounter early returns, three terrain predicates. Actor3 has 489 inhibited and 1845 eligible calls; actor5 has 2335 calls without control ownership. Three requests are accepted and one press is rejected by flags1800. All 66 control artifacts match and 22 corrupted traces are rejected.
validation.tolerance: Exact code/source digests, integer and captured-byte equality, preserved opaque bytes, call order and stack/return relationships. No masks and no universal cadence or full-physics claim.
